items.title: Shelly Berg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You’re in good company then because Roland Hanna just said the same thing. [INTERVIEWEE] Really?

ctx.x: Yeah. I studied classical piano all my life and ended up with a master’s degree in classical piano and conducting from the University of Houston. And I still practice, and I really try to teach all my jazz piano students to love classical music and understand what it can mean to them as jazz pianists.
You’re in good company then because Roland Hanna just said the same thing.
